profile.summary: Softchoice is a North American information technology (IT) solutions provider. It sells and advises on software licensing, especially Microsoft licensing, along with cloud services and modern workplace technology. It is now part of World Wide Technology (WWT), a technology company based in the St. Louis, Missouri area.

review.notes: Softchoice is a well-known Microsoft licensing reseller, now owned by WWT (WWT overview page confirms the acquisition and Microsoft licensing focus), which fits OUSD's Microsoft Volume Licensing enrollment; the Maryland Heights, MO agenda address matches WWT's global headquarters, consistent with post-acquisition billing. The headquarters field is WWT's address, not shown to be Softchoice's own, so it is dropped; the summary is supported and neutral.
